subject: DI03005041

body.en:
Definition

A polymer is a high-molar-mass substance whose molecules contain many connected repeating structural units. A monomer is a small molecule capable of contributing to polymer formation. Degree of polymerisation is the number of repeat units per chain; polymerisation joins monomers, whereas moulding/spinning shapes an already formed polymer.

Classification by stated basis

Origin:natural(cellulose, natural rubber),semi-synthetic(cellulose derivatives) and synthetic(PE, SBR, PET). Structure:linear, branched and cross-linked/network. Thermal behaviour:thermoplastics soften on suitable heating; thermosets form networks that do not remelt reversibly. Mechanical use:plastics, fibres and elastomers. Monomer composition:homopolymers such as PE and copolymers such as SBR. Each basis answers a different question.

Formation and examples

Chain-growth examples include PE and SBR; step-growth examples include nylon6,6 and PET. Condensation often eliminates small molecules, whereas addition reactions need not. Chain-growth/step-growth describes growth mechanism; addition/condensation describes reaction chemistry and should not be treated as perfectly interchangeable terminology. The syllabus examples include thermoplastic PE/nylon/PET, thermosetting PF/UF and elastomeric SBR.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ઘણા connected repeating structural units ધરાવતા high-molar-mass moleculesનો પદાર્થ એટલે polymer. Polymer બનાવવામાં ભાગ લેતું નાનું molecule monomer છે. Chainમાં repeat unitsની સંખ્યા degree of polymerisation છે. Polymerisation monomersને જોડે છે; moulding/spinning પહેલેથી બનેલા polymerને shape આપે છે.

નિર્ધારિત આધાર પ્રમાણે વર્ગીકરણ

Origin મુજબ natural(cellulose, natural rubber),semi-synthetic(cellulose derivatives) તથા synthetic(PE, SBR, PET). Structure મુજબ linear, branched તથા cross-linked/network. Thermal behaviour મુજબ thermoplastics યોગ્ય heatingથી soften થાય છે; thermosetsનું network reversibly remelt થતું નથી. Mechanical use મુજબ plastics, fibres તથા elastomers. Monomer composition મુજબ PE જેવા homopolymers તથા SBR જેવા copolymers. દરેક basis અલગ પ્રશ્નનો જવાબ આપે છે.

Formation તથા ઉદાહરણો

Chain-growthમાં PE/SBR તથા step-growthમાં nylon6,6/PET આવે છે. Condensationમાં ઘણી વખત small molecules છૂટે છે; additionમાં જરૂરી નથી. Chain-growth/step-growth growth mechanism દર્શાવે છે; addition/condensation reaction chemistry દર્શાવે છે,એટલે બંને terminology સંપૂર્ણ interchangeable નથી. Syllabusમાં thermoplastic PE/nylon/PET, thermosetting PF/UF તથા elastomeric SBR છે.

body.en:
General properties

Many polymers have low density, good chemical resistance, electrical insulation and easy shaping, but these are tendencies rather than universal guarantees. Chain structure, molar mass, crystallinity, cross-link density and additives control stiffness, strength, impact resistance and processability. Glass-transition temperature, Tg, marks a change in amorphous-chain mobility; melting temperature, Tm, applies to crystalline regions.

Comparison of the syllabus products

Phillips HDPE:stiff, tough, chemical-resistant; containers, pipes and moulded goods. PF:rigid, heat-resistant, electrically insulating cured network; switchgear parts, handles and laminates. UF:hard, pale-coloured, good adhesive resin; wood panels and moulding powders, but limited moisture/weather resistance. Nylon6,6:strong, abrasion-resistant fibre/engineering polymer; cords, textiles and gears, with moisture absorption affecting dimensions. SBR:abrasion-resistant elastomer after suitable compounding/vulcanisation; tyres, belts and footwear, but limited resistance to oils and ozone without suitable formulation. PET fibre:strong, crease-resistant and low in moisture uptake; textiles, blends and industrial yarns.

Selection limitations

Check temperature, load, creep, solvent exposure, flammability and ageing rather than selecting only by appearance. Filled, plasticised and reinforced grades differ from neat polymer. Recyclability depends on resin, additives, contamination and actual collection/reprocessing infrastructure; thermosets cannot simply be remelted like clean thermoplastics.
body.gu:
સામાન્ય ગુણધર્મો

ઘણા polymersમાં low density, chemical resistance, electrical insulation તથા easy shaping મળે છે,પરંતુ આ tendencies છે,universal guarantees નહીં. Chain structure, molar mass, crystallinity, cross-link density તથા additivesથી stiffness, strength, impact resistance/processability નક્કી થાય છે. Tg amorphous-chain mobilityનો ફેરફાર બતાવે છે; Tm crystalline regionsના melting માટે છે.

Syllabusના Productsની સરખામણી

Phillips HDPE stiff, tough તથા chemical-resistant છે: containers, pipes, moulded goods. Cured PF rigid, heat-resistant તથા electrically insulating છે: switchgear parts, handles, laminates. UF hard, pale-coloured તથા adhesive resin છે: wood panels/moulding powders,પરંતુ moisture/weather resistance મર્યાદિત. Nylon6,6 strong તથા abrasion-resistant છે: cords, textiles, gears; moisture absorptionથી dimensions બદલાય છે. યોગ્ય compounding/vulcanisation પછી SBR abrasion-resistant elastomer બને છે: tyres, belts, footwear; formulation વગર oil/ozone resistance મર્યાદિત. PET fibre strong, crease-resistant તથા low-moisture-uptake છે: textiles, blends, industrial yarns.

પસંદગીની મર્યાદા

ફક્ત દેખાવ નહીં,temperature, load, creep, solvents, flammability તથા ageing પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરવું. Filled, plasticised તથા reinforced grades neat polymerથી જુદા છે. Recyclability resin, additives, contamination તથા actual collection/reprocessing infrastructure પર આધારિત છે; thermosetsને clean thermoplasticsની જેમ remelt કરી શકાતાં નથી.

body.en:
Definition

The Phillips process polymerises ethylene using an activated supported chromium-oxide catalyst to produce mainly high-density polyethylene; this drawing selects a solution-recovery route.

Raw materials and reaction principle

High-purity ethylene, hydrocarbon solvent and an activated supported chromium-oxide catalyst. Oxygen, moisture and catalyst poisons are excluded as required by the catalyst system.

nCH2=CH2 → [–CH2–CH2–]n; reaction releases heat.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Purification and reactor feed—E01–E03

Ethylene is purified and mixed with suitable hydrocarbon solvent and controlled catalyst feed. The reactor provides agitation/contacting and heat removal so ethylene reaches the catalyst sites without local overheating. The selected solution route uses conditions at which polymer is carried in hot solvent; industrial Phillips technology also includes other reactor/recovery variants. Supported chromium oxide distinguishes this chemistry from a Ziegler titanium/aluminium system.

2. Polymerisation and monomer recovery—E03–E05

Ethylene adds repeatedly at active catalyst sites to form long chains. Temperature, residence time, catalyst characteristics and feed composition affect polymer molar mass and grade. Unreacted ethylene is separated from the reactor effluent and returned to feed preparation. Hot catalyst-fines removal is shown for this selected solution finishing train; it is not a claim that every modern Phillips plant must use the identical filtration stage.

3. Precipitation, drying and solvent recycle—E06–E09

Cooling reduces polymer solubility so PE precipitates. Filtration separates polymer from mother-liquor solvent; drying removes residual volatile material before pelletising/finishing. Solvent recovery removes wax/heavy impurities and returns suitable solvent to feed. Closing both ethylene and solvent loops improves yield and solvent economy, while a controlled purge limits contaminant accumulation.

Operating and engineering considerations

The bottom of owner page6is a generic metal-oxide PE scheme; the upper ICI high-pressure free-radical scheme is not Phillips. The selected supported-chromium route must retain its own catalyst identity. Control heat removal, feed purity, flammable solvent containment and chromium-bearing waste.

Applications / uses

HDPE is relatively stiff, tough and chemically resistant; used for pipes, containers, bottles and engineering/moulded articles according to grade.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Activated supported chromium-oxide catalystથી ethyleneનું polymerisation કરી મુખ્યત્વે HDPE બનાવવાની પદ્ધતિ Phillips process છે; અહીં solution-recovery route પસંદ છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

High-purity ethylene, hydrocarbon solvent તથા activated supported chromium-oxide catalyst લેવાય છે. Catalyst system પ્રમાણે oxygen, moisture તથા poisons દૂર રાખાય છે.

nCH2=CH2 → [–CH2–CH2–]n; reaction releases heat.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Purification તથા Reactor feed—E01–E03

Ethylene purify થયા પછી suitable hydrocarbon solvent તથા controlled catalyst feed સાથે reactorમાં જાય છે. Agitation/contacting તથા heat removalથી ethylene catalyst sites સુધી પહોંચે છે અને local overheating અટકે છે. Selected solution routeમાં hot solvent polymerને વહન કરે છે; industrial Phillips technologyમાં બીજી reactor/recovery variants પણ છે. Supported chromium oxide chemistry, Zieglerના titanium/aluminium systemથી જુદી છે.

2. Polymerisation તથા Monomer recovery—E03–E05

Active catalyst sites પર ethylene વારંવાર add થઈ long chains બનાવે છે. Temperature, residence time, catalyst characteristics તથા feed compositionથી molar mass/grade નક્કી થાય છે. Unreacted ethylene effluentમાંથી અલગ થઈ feedમાં પાછું જાય છે. આ selected solution finishing trainમાં hot catalyst-fines removal બતાવ્યું છે; દરેક modern Phillips plantમાં એ જ filtration હોવું જરૂરી એવો દાવો નથી.

3. Precipitation, drying તથા Solvent recycle—E06–E09

Coolingથી polymer solubility ઘટતાં PE precipitate થાય છે. Filtration polymerને mother-liquor solventથી જુદું કરે છે; drying પછી residual volatiles દૂર થઈ pelletising/finishing થાય છે. Solvent recovery wax/heavy impurities દૂર કરીને solvent feedમાં પાછું મોકલે છે. Ethylene તથા solvent બંને recycleથી yield/economy સુધરે છે; controlled purge contaminantsનું accumulation રોકે છે.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Owner પાના6નું નીચેનું diagram generic metal-oxide PE scheme છે; ઉપરની ICI high-pressure free-radical route Phillips નથી. અહીં supported-chromium routeની catalyst identity જાળવી છે. Heat removal, feed purity, flammable-solvent containment તથા chromium-bearing waste નિયંત્રિત કરવાં.

ઉપયોગો

HDPE relatively stiff, tough તથા chemically resistant છે; grade મુજબ pipes, containers, bottles તથા engineering/moulded articlesમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

Phenol–formaldehyde(PF) resin is a condensation resin formed from phenol and formaldehyde; curing develops an infusible cross-linked thermoset.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Phenol, formaldehyde and route-specific catalyst; solvent/modifier as needed. Novolac normally uses acid catalysis and phenol excess, then hexamine curing; resol normally uses base catalysis and formaldehyde excess.

Phenol + formaldehyde → methylol phenols → methylene/methylene-ether-linked resin + water during condensation; cross-linking continues during cure.

Primary flowsheet—your supplied PDF, page 8

How to read the supplied drawing

Follow the kettle’s three branches separately. The solid route includes the water-cooled belt, crusher,200-mesh screen, hexamine/lubricant blending, resin storage, filler/plasticiser mixing, differential heated rolls, cooling belt and final grinder.

1. Batch resin kettle and volatile control

The supplied kettle has an agitator, heating/cooling provision and an overhead condenser/reflux arrangement. Phenol or cresol, formaldehyde, catalyst, solvent and modifier are processed according to the selected resin formulation. Initial methylolation introduces reactive groups; condensation increases chain size. Heating initiates/progresses the reaction, and cooling controls the exotherm and prevents premature gelation. The generic PDF supports several product branches; its liquid and solid branches must not all be described as one fixed novolac recipe.

2. Liquid-resin branches in the supplied PDF

The left branch sends resin in solvent through cooling toward laminating resins/coatings. The adjacent branch sends suitable resin in aqueous form through cooling toward adhesives/coatings. Solubility and final formulation depend on resin chemistry; water is not a universal solvent for every cured PF grade. These branches bypass the full moulding-powder finishing line.

3. Solid-resin cooling, crushing and formulation

The molten-resin branch runs over the water-cooled conveyor, then through crushing and screening; the PDF labels a200-mesh screen. Hexamethylenetetramine(hexamine) and lubricant are blended with the appropriate novolac resin powder. Resin storage then feeds the formulation mixer with fillers/plasticiser. Hexamine serves as a curing agent, not merely an inert filler. The200-mesh label belongs to this reference layout, not a universal specification for all PF powders.

4. Heated rolls, cooling and moulding powder

Differential heated rolls mix and distribute resin/additives into a uniform sheet while avoiding complete cure. The sheet is cooled on a belt, ground and collected as thermosetting moulding powder. During later hot moulding, the curing system forms the rigid network. Thus resin manufacture, powder compounding and final mould curing are separate operations.

Simplified study redraw—equipment IDs are for this redraw only

Operating and engineering considerations

Control catalyst/monomer ratio, viscosity, water removal, free phenol/formaldehyde and curing tendency. Phenol toxicity, formaldehyde vapour and dust require enclosed handling. The clean redraw groups early cooling/crushing/screening; the original sequence above is the reference working.

Applications / uses

Cured PF is rigid, heat-resistant and a useful electrical insulator:handles, switchgear parts, laminates, adhesives and coatings.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Phenol તથા formaldehydeની condensation resin એટલે PF; curingથી infusible cross-linked thermoset બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Phenol, formaldehyde તથા route-specific catalyst; જરૂર મુજબ solvent/modifier. Novolacમાં સામાન્ય રીતે acid catalyst તથા phenol excess પછી hexamine curing; resolમાં base catalyst તથા formaldehyde excess હોય છે.

Phenol + formaldehyde → methylol phenols → methylene/methylene-ether-linked resin + water during condensation; cross-linking continues during cure.

મુખ્ય flowsheet—તમે મોકલેલી PDF,પાનું 8

મૂળ drawing કેવી રીતે સમજવી

Kettleની ત્રણ branches જુદી અનુસરો. Solid routeમાં water-cooled belt, crusher,200-mesh screen, hexamine/lubricant blending, resin storage, filler/plasticiser mixing, differential heated rolls, cooling belt તથા final grinder છે.

1. Batch resin kettle તથા Volatile control

મૂળ kettleમાં agitator, heating/cooling provision તથા overhead condenser/reflux છે. Phenol/cresol, formaldehyde, catalyst, solvent તથા modifier selected formulation પ્રમાણે process થાય છે. Initial methylolation reactive groups આપે છે; condensationથી chain size વધે છે. Heatingથી reaction આગળ વધે છે અને cooling exotherm/premature gelation નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Generic PDFમાં અનેક product branches છે; બધા liquid/solid branchesને એક fixed novolac recipe ગણવી નહીં.

2. મૂળ PDFની Liquid-resin branches

ડાબી branchમાં solventવાળી resin cooling પછી laminating resins/coatingsમાં જાય છે. બાજુની branchમાં suitable aqueous resin cooling પછી adhesives/coatingsમાં જાય છે. Solubility તથા formulation resin chemistry પર આધારિત છે; water દરેક cured PF gradeનો universal solvent નથી. આ branches સંપૂર્ણ moulding-powder finishing lineમાંથી પસાર થતી નથી.

3. Solid-resin cooling, crushing તથા Formulation

Molten-resin branch water-cooled conveyor પછી crushing/screeningમાં જાય છે; PDFમાં200-mesh screen બતાવ્યું છે. Appropriate novolac powder સાથે hexamethylenetetramine(hexamine) તથા lubricant blend થાય છે. Resin storage પછી fillers/plasticiser સાથે formulation mixerમાં જાય છે. Hexamine curing agent છે,inert filler નહીં.200-mesh આ referenceનું label છે,દરેક PF powderનું universal specification નહીં.

4. Heated rolls, cooling તથા Moulding powder

Differential heated rolls resin/additivesને uniform sheetમાં mix/distribute કરે છે,પરંતુ complete cure થવા દેતા નથી. Sheet belt પર cool થઈ grind થાય છે અને thermosetting moulding powder મળે છે. પછી hot moulding દરમિયાન curing system rigid network બનાવે છે. એટલે resin manufacture, powder compounding તથા final mould curing જુદાં operations છે.

Simplified study redraw—E numbers ફક્ત આ redraw માટે છે

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Catalyst/monomer ratio, viscosity, water removal, free phenol/formaldehyde તથા curing tendency નિયંત્રિત કરવાં. Phenol toxicity, formaldehyde vapour તથા dust માટે enclosed handling જોઈએ. Clean redraw early cooling/crushing/screeningને group કરે છે; ઉપર મૂળ sequence મુજબ working છે.

ઉપયોગો

Cured PF rigid, heat-resistant તથા electrical insulator છે: handles, switchgear parts, laminates, adhesives અને coatingsમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

Urea–formaldehyde(UF) resin is a thermosetting amino resin formed by methylolation and condensation of urea with formaldehyde.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Urea, aqueous formaldehyde, alkaline/acid pH-control chemicals and formulation additives as required.

Urea + formaldehyde → methylol ureas(addition);methylol ureas → methylene/ether-linked UF resin + water during condensation.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Methylolation and condensation—E01–E02

Urea and formaldehyde are mixed in an agitated, temperature-controlled reactor. Under an appropriate mildly alkaline stage, formaldehyde forms methylol urea derivatives. The mixture is then shifted to a controlled acidic condensation stage, which links the derivatives and increases resin molar mass/viscosity. pH change is a deliberate stage function, not the arbitrary addition of both catalysts at once.

2. Stabilisation and liquid-resin finishing—E03–E05

At the required condensation level, the pH is adjusted to slow further reaction and the resin is cooled. Vacuum concentration removes water at a lower liquid temperature and sets the required solids content. A stabilised liquid adhesive can be withdrawn from storage. Formulation may include staged urea addition to control residual formaldehyde and storage behaviour; the exact recipe is grade-dependent.

3. Powder formulation and cure—E06–E08

For a powder product, the resin is blended with suitable filler/additives, dried under controlled conditions and ground/packed. Drying must remove water without causing complete premature cure. In later use, the curing conditions/hardener produce a cross-linked adhesive or moulded article. The finished thermoset does not melt back into the original liquid resin.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control pH, temperature, viscosity, solids content, free formaldehyde, storage stability and cure time. Avoid uncontrolled gelation and provide formaldehyde exposure/emission control.

Applications / uses

Hard, pale-coloured adhesive/moulding resin for plywood, particleboard, MDF and suitable moulded articles. Moisture/weather resistance and formaldehyde-emission limits restrict service.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Urea તથા formaldehydeના methylolation અને condensationથી બનતી thermosetting amino resin એટલે UF.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Urea, aqueous formaldehyde, alkaline/acid pH-control chemicals તથા જરૂરી formulation additives લેવાય છે.

Urea + formaldehyde → methylol ureas(addition);methylol ureas → methylene/ether-linked UF resin + water during condensation.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Methylolation તથા Condensation—E01–E02

Urea તથા formaldehyde agitated, temperature-controlled reactorમાં mix થાય છે. યોગ્ય mildly alkaline stageમાં methylol urea derivatives બને છે. પછી controlled acidic stageમાં condensationથી derivatives જોડાય છે અને molar mass/viscosity વધે છે. pH change stage પ્રમાણે થાય છે; બંને catalysts એકસાથે મનસ્વી રીતે ઉમેરાતા નથી.

2. Stabilisation તથા Liquid-resin finishing—E03–E05

જરૂરી condensation level પર pH adjust કરીને reaction ધીમી કરાય છે અને resin cool થાય છે. Vacuum concentrationથી ઓછા liquid temperatureએ water દૂર થાય છે અને solids content મળે છે. Stabilised liquid adhesive storageમાંથી મળે છે. Residual formaldehyde/storage behaviour માટે staged urea addition હોઈ શકે; ચોક્કસ recipe grade પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે.

3. Powder formulation તથા Cure—E06–E08

Powder product માટે resin suitable filler/additives સાથે blend થઈ controlled drying પછી grind/pack થાય છે. Water દૂર થવું જોઈએ,પરંતુ premature complete cure નહીં. પછીના ઉપયોગમાં curing conditions/hardenerથી cross-linked adhesive અથવા moulded article બને છે. Finished thermoset ફરી મૂળ liquid resinમાં melt થતું નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

pH, temperature, viscosity, solids content, free formaldehyde, storage stability તથા cure time નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Uncontrolled gelation અટકાવવું અને formaldehyde exposure/emission control રાખવું.

ઉપયોગો

Hard, pale-coloured adhesive/moulding resin: plywood, particleboard, MDF તથા suitable moulded articlesમાં ઉપયોગ. Moisture/weather resistance તથા formaldehyde-emission limits service મર્યાદિત કરે છે.

body.en:
Definition

Nylon6,6 is a polyamide formed from adipic acid and hexamethylenediamine; the two6s denote the six-carbon acid and six-carbon diamine.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Adipic acid, hexamethylenediamine, water and a controlled chain regulator where specified. The PDF labels acetic acid as a regulator and Dowtherm as a heat-transfer medium; Dowtherm is not a nylon monomer.

Each amide linkage:–COOH + H2N– → –CONH– + H2O. Repeat unit:[–NH–(CH2)6–NH–CO–(CH2)4–CO–]n; water is removed during polycondensation.

Primary flowsheet—your supplied PDF, page 9

How to read the supplied drawing

Follow salt vessel → evaporator → polymeriser → water-cooled casting roll → chopper → nylon resin. For fibre, continue resin → melt tank/filter → melt spinning → air/steam conditioning → cold drawing → filament/thread.

1. Nylon-salt preparation and evaporation

The stirred salt vessel combines adipic acid and hexamethylenediamine in closely balanced proportions to form nylon salt in water. Monomer balance matters because excess end groups limit chain length. The evaporator concentrates the salt solution and removes water before the nylon polymeriser. Steam and Dowtherm connections shown in the PDF supply heat; they are utility streams rather than chain-building reactants.

2. Polycondensation and chip formation

In the heated polymeriser, nylon-salt components form amide bonds while condensation water is removed. The melt is advanced to the required viscosity under controlled thermal history. The supplied route discharges melt to the water-cooled casting roll, forms a ribbon and chops it into nylon-resin chips. A branch sells/uses these chips as resin; the fibre route remelts them. This is not caprolactam ring-opening to nylon6.

3. Melt tank, filter and spinning

For fibres, the chips are appropriately dried and fed to the heated melt tank with the reference nitrogen-pressure protection. Molten polymer passes through the melt filter and metering/spinning unit, which forces it through fine spinneret holes. Filtration prevents particle blockage and filament defects. Air quenching solidifies the extruded filaments; controlled heating avoids polymer degradation during the remelt stage.

4. Conditioning, cold drawing and winding

The PDF shows a steam conditioner and cold-drawing rolls after spinning. Drawing stretches and aligns chains along the fibre axis, improving tensile strength and dimensional behaviour. Conditioned, drawn filaments are wound as yarn/thread for textiles or industrial reinforcement. Spinning gives the filament shape; drawing develops useful orientation, and neither should be called the chemical polymerisation step.

Simplified study redraw—equipment IDs are for this redraw only

Operating and engineering considerations

Control monomer stoichiometry, water removal, melt viscosity, chip dryness, thermal oxidation, filter pressure drop and draw conditions. The owner PDF is the primary chip/remelt sequence; the simplified redraw also shows the possibility of direct-melt fibre finishing as an alternate arrangement, not as the same exact PDF route.

Applications / uses

Strong, abrasion-resistant fibres for textiles, cords and industrial yarn; resin grades for gears, bearings and engineering mouldings. Moisture absorption affects properties/dimensions.

body.en:
Definition

SBR is an elastomeric copolymer of styrene and1,3-butadiene; this flowsheet uses emulsion polymerisation followed by crumb recovery.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Styrene, butadiene, water, emulsifying soap, initiator/regulator system, short-stop agent and controlled coagulant.

Styrene + butadiene → styrene–butadiene copolymer; both monomer types enter the chain without a condensation-water by-product.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Emulsion preparation and cooled reactor train—E01–E02

The monomers are dispersed in water with emulsifier and introduced into a series of agitated, cooled reactors. An initiator starts chain growth in dispersed polymer particles; the modifier/regulator helps control molar mass. Cold-emulsion SBR is commonly described near5°C, whereas hot-emulsion routes use higher temperatures. The chosen emulsion route is not solution-SBR technology and must not be explained with a solvent-only feed.

2. Short-stop and monomer recovery—E03–E05

At the selected conversion, a short-stop agent terminates further polymerisation to protect grade consistency and processability. Unreacted butadiene is flashed/recovered, and styrene is stripped from the latex in separate recovery service. Both return to controlled feed preparation after conditioning. Stopping before complete monomer exhaustion is therefore compatible with recovery and does not mean the remaining monomer is intentionally left in finished rubber.

3. Coagulation, washing and drying—E06–E09

After monomer removal, the stable latex is deliberately coagulated to rubber crumb. Washing removes soluble emulsifier/coagulant residues, and mechanical dewatering reduces the dryer load. Controlled drying gives rubber suitable for baling/packing. Compounding with fillers, antioxidants and a curing system occurs later; vulcanisation cross-links the rubber and is not the original styrene–butadiene copolymerisation.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control heat removal, emulsion stability, conversion, monomer recovery and residual volatiles. Owner page7is generic vinyl polymerisation, not an explicitly labelled SBR process; this own syllabus-specific flowsheet is used.

Applications / uses

After appropriate compounding/cure, SBR gives abrasion-resistant tyre tread, belts, hoses, footwear and other rubber goods. Oil/ozone resistance requires suitable material/formulation selection.

વ્યાખ્યા

Styrene તથા1,3-butadieneનો elastomeric copolymer SBR છે; આ flowsheet emulsion polymerisation પછી crumb recovery બતાવે છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Styrene, butadiene, water, emulsifying soap, initiator/regulator system, short-stop agent તથા controlled coagulant લેવાય છે.

Styrene + butadiene → styrene–butadiene copolymer; both monomer types enter the chain without a condensation-water by-product.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Emulsion preparation તથા Cooled reactor train—E01–E02

Monomersને emulsifierથી waterમાં disperse કરીને agitated, cooled reactor seriesમાં મોકલાય છે. Initiator dispersed polymer particlesમાં chain growth શરૂ કરે છે; modifier/regulator molar mass નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Cold-emulsion SBR સામાન્ય રીતે લગભગ5°C નજીક વર્ણવાય છે; hot-emulsion routes વધુ temperatureએ થાય છે. આ emulsion route solution-SBR નથી,એટલે solvent-only feedથી સમજાવવી નહીં.

2. Short-stop તથા Monomer recovery—E03–E05

પસંદ કરેલા conversion પર short-stop agent polymerisation રોકે છે,જેથી grade consistency/processability જળવાય. Unreacted butadiene flash/recover થાય છે અને styrene latexમાંથી separate strippingથી મળે છે. Conditioning પછી બંને feed preparationમાં પાછાં જાય છે. એટલે complete conversion પહેલાં reaction રોકી recovery કરાય છે; finished rubberમાં monomer જાણે કરીને બાકી રાખાતું નથી.

3. Coagulation, washing તથા Drying—E06–E09

Monomer removal પછી stable latexને coagulate કરીને rubber crumb બનાવાય છે. Washingથી soluble emulsifier/coagulant residues દૂર થાય છે અને mechanical dewatering dryer load ઘટાડે છે. Controlled drying પછી rubber baling/packingમાં જાય છે. Fillers, antioxidants તથા curing system સાથે compounding પાછળ થાય છે; vulcanisation rubberને cross-link કરે છે,તે મૂળ copolymerisation નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Heat removal, emulsion stability, conversion, monomer recovery તથા residual volatiles નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Owner પાનું7 generic vinyl polymerisation છે,explicit SBR process નથી; તેથી આ syllabus-specific flowsheet વાપરી છે.

ઉપયોગો

યોગ્ય compounding/cure પછી abrasion-resistant tyre tread, belts, hoses, footwear તથા rubber goodsમાં ઉપયોગ. Oil/ozone resistance માટે યોગ્ય material/formulation પસંદ કરવી.

body.en:
Definition

PET polyester fibre is made by producing polyethylene terephthalate through step-growth chemistry and then melt-spinning/drawing the polymer.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Dimethyl terephthalate(DMT),ethylene glycol(EG) and suitable catalysts. This selected route is DMT/EG; PTA/EG is an alternative with different early-stage by-products.

DMT + 2EG → bis(2-hydroxyethyl)terephthalate(BHET) + 2CH3OH; BHET/oligomers → PET + removed EG. PET repeat:[–O–CH2–CH2–O–CO–C6H4–CO–]n.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Ester interchange and prepolymer—E01–E02

DMT reacts with excess EG in an agitated, heated ester-interchange stage. Methanol is distilled off as it forms, driving the conversion toward hydroxyethyl ester intermediates. Further reaction forms low-molar-mass oligomers in the prepolymer stage. Methanol recovery belongs to this DMT route; using water as the sole first-stage by-product would instead describe PTA esterification.

2. Vacuum polycondensation and glycol recovery—E03/E09

The viscous prepolymer enters a heated vacuum polycondensation unit. Good surface renewal and low volatile partial pressure help remove EG and build chain length. Recovered glycol vapour is condensed/purified and returned where quality permits. Temperature and residence time must provide adequate reaction without excessive colour formation or degradation. The reactor outlet is polymer melt, not yet a drawn textile fibre.

3. Filtration, spinning and orientation—E04–E08

The melt passes through filtration/metering and fine spinneret holes. Cooling air solidifies the filaments, which are then drawn to orient chains and heat-set to stabilise dimensions. The finished fibre/yarn is wound. Contaminant particles and moisture can break filaments or reduce molar mass by hydrolysis; proper drying is essential whenever stored PET chips are remelted instead of using a direct melt line.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control monomer ratio, catalyst, by-product removal, vacuum, melt viscosity, filtration and drawing/heat setting. Methanol and EG streams require contained recovery; do not combine DMT and PTA mass balances.

Applications / uses

Strong, crease-resistant, low-moisture-uptake fibre for apparel, blends, tyre/industrial yarn and technical textiles; PET resin also has non-fibre grades.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Step-growth chemistryથી polyethylene terephthalate બનાવ્યા પછી melt-spinning/drawingથી PET polyester fibre બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Dimethyl terephthalate(DMT),ethylene glycol(EG) તથા suitable catalysts લેવાય છે. Selected route DMT/EG છે; PTA/EG alternativeમાં early-stage by-products જુદાં છે.

DMT + 2EG → bis(2-hydroxyethyl)terephthalate(BHET) + 2CH3OH; BHET/oligomers → PET + removed EG. PET repeat:[–O–CH2–CH2–O–CO–C6H4–CO–]n.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Ester interchange તથા Prepolymer—E01–E02

DMT excess EG સાથે agitated, heated ester-interchange stageમાં react કરે છે. બનેલું methanol distil થવાથી hydroxyethyl ester intermediates તરફ conversion વધે છે. Prepolymer stageમાં વધુ reactionથી low-molar-mass oligomers બને છે. Methanol recovery આ DMT routeની છે; ફક્ત waterને first-stage by-product કહીએ તો PTA esterificationની સમજણ થઈ જાય.

2. Vacuum polycondensation તથા Glycol recovery—E03/E09

Viscous prepolymer heated vacuum polycondensation unitમાં જાય છે. Surface renewal તથા low volatile partial pressureથી EG દૂર થાય છે અને chain length વધે છે. Recovered glycol vapour condense/purify થઈ quality મુજબ પાછું વપરાય છે. Temperature/residence timeથી પૂરતી reaction થાય,પણ excess colour/degradation નહીં. Reactor outlet polymer melt છે,હજી drawn textile fibre નથી.

3. Filtration, spinning તથા Orientation—E04–E08

Melt filtration/metering પછી fine spinneret holesમાંથી નીકળે છે. Cooling airથી filaments solid થાય છે; drawingથી chains orient થાય છે અને heat-settingથી dimensions સ્થિર થાય છે. Finished fibre/yarn wind થાય છે. Particles તથા moistureથી filament breaks અથવા hydrolysisથી molar mass ઘટે છે; direct meltના બદલે stored chips remelt કરીએ ત્યારે યોગ્ય drying જરૂરી છે.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Monomer ratio, catalyst, by-product removal, vacuum, melt viscosity, filtration તથા drawing/heat setting નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Methanol/EGનું contained recovery જોઈએ; DMT તથા PTAના mass balances ભેળવવા નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Strong, crease-resistant, low-moisture-uptake fibre: apparel, blends, tyre/industrial yarn તથા technical textiles; PET resinના non-fibre grades પણ હોય છે.

body.en:
Aim

Identify selected polymers by simple tests

Principle

Appearance, density tendency and controlled thermal response help classify polymers, but no single simple test proves a commercial grade’s identity. Fillers/additives change behaviour.

Apparatus and approved materials

Labelled reference specimens, water-density setup, balance if required and a teacher-approved controlled heating/softening arrangement. No routine flame/smell identification.

Supervised procedure / process record

Code unknowns and compare with known references. Record appearance/flexibility and float/sink behaviour without assuming porosity-free samples. Observe controlled softening only in the authorised setup to distinguish thermoplastic tendencies from a cured thermoset. Combine evidence and report tentative identity/confidence; never inhale fumes or burn unknown plastics such as possible PVC.

Observations to record—leave actual values blank until performed

Specimen code:____;reference:____;appearance/flexibility:____;density test:____;controlled thermal response:____;tentative class/identity:____;limitations:____.

Precautions and evidence

Work only in the supervised institutional laboratory under the instructor-approved SOP and current SDS. Confirm ventilation, PPE, compatible equipment, waste container and emergency arrangements before starting. Do not taste/smell products or invent readings. Record date, SOP reference, actual observations and teacher verification; hazardous preparations below are study support, not standalone operating recipes.

Measured result:____;specified units/grade:____;uncertainty or deviation:____;conclusion from actual evidence:____.

Authorised setupમાં controlled softeningથી thermoplastic tendency/cured thermoset ભેદ observe કરો. title.en: How to study a manufacturing answer

body.en: State the product and route,raw materials and reaction;draw the correctly labelled flowsheet;explain each stage in arrow order with recycle/by-products;finish with key controls and uses. Equipment in original supplied scans must be identified by their printed names;E-numbers refer only to new study redraws.
body.gu: Product/route,raw materials તથા reaction લખો;સાચી labelled flowsheet દોરો;arrow order મુજબ દરેક stage તથા recycle/by-products સમજાવો;છેલ્લે key controls/uses આપો. મૂળ scansના equipmentને તેમના printed namesથી ઓળખો;E numbers ફક્ત નવા study redraws માટે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Classification of polymers.

a.en: A polymer is a high-molar-mass substance whose molecules contain many connected repeating structural units. A monomer is a small molecule capable of contributing to polymer formation. Degree of polymerisation is the number of repeat units per chain; polymerisation joins monomers, whereas moulding/spinning shapes an already formed polymer.
a.gu: ઘણા connected repeating structural units ધરાવતા high-molar-mass moleculesનો પદાર્થ એટલે polymer. Polymer બનાવવામાં ભાગ લેતું નાનું molecule monomer છે. Chainમાં repeat unitsની સંખ્યા degree of polymerisation છે. Polymerisation monomersને જોડે છે; moulding/spinning પહેલેથી બનેલા polymerને shape આપે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Polymer properties and uses.
q.gu: પોલિમર્સના ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Many polymers have low density, good chemical resistance, electrical insulation and easy shaping, but these are tendencies rather than universal guarantees. Chain structure, molar mass, crystallinity, cross-link density and additives control stiffness, strength, impact resistance and processability. Glass-transition temperature, Tg, marks a change in amorphous-chain mobility; melting temperature, Tm, applies to crystalline regions.
a.gu: ઘણા polymersમાં low density, chemical resistance, electrical insulation તથા easy shaping મળે છે,પરંતુ આ tendencies છે,universal guarantees નહીં. Chain structure, molar mass, crystallinity, cross-link density તથા additivesથી stiffness, strength, impact resistance/processability નક્કી થાય છે. Tg amorphous-chain mobilityનો ફેરફાર બતાવે છે; Tm crystalline regionsના melting માટે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Polyethylene—Phillips process.

a.en: The Phillips process polymerises ethylene using an activated supported chromium-oxide catalyst to produce mainly high-density polyethylene; this drawing selects a solution-recovery route.
a.gu: Activated supported chromium-oxide catalystથી ethyleneનું polymerisation કરી મુખ્યત્વે HDPE બનાવવાની પદ્ધતિ Phillips process છે; અહીં solution-recovery route પસંદ છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Phenol–formaldehyde resin.

a.en: Phenol–formaldehyde(PF) resin is a condensation resin formed from phenol and formaldehyde; curing develops an infusible cross-linked thermoset.
a.gu: Phenol તથા formaldehydeની condensation resin એટલે PF; curingથી infusible cross-linked thermoset બને છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Urea–formaldehyde resin.

a.en: Urea–formaldehyde(UF) resin is a thermosetting amino resin formed by methylolation and condensation of urea with formaldehyde.
a.gu: Urea તથા formaldehydeના methylolation અને condensationથી બનતી thermosetting amino resin એટલે UF.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Nylon 6,6 resin and fibre.
q.gu: Nylon 6,6 Resin તથા Fibreની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Nylon6,6 is a polyamide formed from adipic acid and hexamethylenediamine; the two6s denote the six-carbon acid and six-carbon diamine.
a.gu: Adipic acid તથા hexamethylenediamineમાંથી બનતી polyamide એટલે Nylon6,6; બે6,છ-carbon acid તથા છ-carbon diamine બતાવે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Styrene–butadiene rubber.

a.en: SBR is an elastomeric copolymer of styrene and1,3-butadiene; this flowsheet uses emulsion polymerisation followed by crumb recovery.
a.gu: Styrene તથા1,3-butadieneનો elastomeric copolymer SBR છે; આ flowsheet emulsion polymerisation પછી crumb recovery બતાવે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Polyester fibre—PET.

a.en: PET polyester fibre is made by producing polyethylene terephthalate through step-growth chemistry and then melt-spinning/drawing the polymer.
a.gu: Step-growth chemistryથી polyethylene terephthalate બનાવ્યા પછી melt-spinning/drawingથી PET polyester fibre બને છે.

q.en: Classify polymers with examples under different stated bases.
q.gu: જુદા stated bases મુજબ examples સાથે polymers classify કરો.

q.en: Compare properties and uses of HDPE,PF,UF,nylon6,6,SBR and PET fibre.
q.gu: HDPE,PF,UF,nylon6,6,SBR તથા PET fibreના properties/uses compare કરો.

q.en: Explain Phillips polyethylene manufacture with catalyst identity and monomer/solvent recovery.
q.gu: Catalyst identity તથા monomer/solvent recovery સાથે Phillips polyethylene manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain PF production using the supplied liquid-resin and moulding-powder branches.
q.gu: મૂળ liquid-resin તથા moulding-powder branches પ્રમાણે PF production સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain staged-pH UF resin manufacture and finishing.
q.gu: Staged-pH UF resin manufacture તથા finishing સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain the supplied nylon6,6 chip/remelt/fibre sequence with conditioning and drawing.
q.gu: મૂળ nylon6,6 chip/remelt/fibre sequence,conditioning તથા drawing સાથે સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain emulsion SBR manufacture with monomer recovery and crumb finishing.
q.gu: Monomer recovery તથા crumb finishing સાથે emulsion SBR manufacture સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain PET fibre manufacture by the DMT/EG route and identify its recovered by-products.
q.gu: DMT/EG routeથી PET fibre manufacture તથા recovered by-products સમજાવો.
